question: Chronic misuse of exogenous anabolic-androgenic steroids suppresses endogenous LH and FSH secretion via negative feedback, leading to testicular atrophy and azoospermia.

l10n.wrongAnswerMessage: This statement is true. Exogenous androgens mimic testosterone's negative feedback on the hypothalamus and pituitary, suppressing LH/FSH and causing reversible (sometimes irreversible) testicular atrophy.
l10n.correctAnswerMessage: Correct! Supraphysiological androgens exert prolonged negative feedback on the HPG axis, reducing LH and FSH to near-zero, causing testicular atrophy, reduced spermatogenesis, and infertility.
